entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I've had it for a few weeks and it's absolutely impossible. This is ridiculous!

I'm very sorry to hear you're having a frustrating experience. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's not a 'preference,' it's just plain bad! The interface is so confusing, it's incredibly hard to use. I've read the user manual front to back and it's useless. I expected more from VeloFit, frankly. I'm a long-time customer, and this is the worst product you've ever made.
I understand. It sounds like the device isn't as intuitive as you were hoping it would be. I can see you purchased this about 25 days ago. Let me just check the policy for you, one moment.

Don't give me the runaround with some policy. I want my money back, and if I don't get it, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Do you want that? I can get a manager on the phone right now if you can't handle this.

There's no need for that, sir. I can definitely handle this for you. I've just confirmed the policy. Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is a standard item and it's well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Oh. Okay. So you're just going to do it?

Yes, of course. I'm also noting in your account that you're one of our VIP customers, and we sincerely value your loyalty. I apologize again for the frustration this product has caused. As a courtesy, I'm processing your return with a prepaid shipping label, and I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for you to use on a future purchase.
A prepaid label and a credit? Well... that's... better. That's good service. I appreciate you taking care of it without a fight.

It's my pleasure. Our goal is to make sure you're happy with your VeloFit experience, even if a particular product isn't the right fit. I've just sent the return instructions and the shipping label to the email address on file. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
